subject: Acme Health PoC: success criteria & final readout scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Health — discovery recap & next steps (PoC planning)

Hi Sam / Olivia —

Thanks again for the intro call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we start the PoC:

Summary of needs (from the call)
- 1–2 high-throughput inference flows for clinical note summarization and triage routing.
- Data security: VPC + SOC2 evidence required for internal stakeholders.
- Latency SLO: 250ms p50 for the summarization endpoint; throughput ~200 req/min during business hours.

Proposed PoC scope & success criteria (attached: PoC-SuccessCriteria.xlsx)
- Technical: ingest sample batch, validate latency and throughput targets, verify KV-caching reduces token cost by >=30%.
- Quality: F1 >= 0.85 on summary extractive metrics across provided eval set.
- Security: attestation that logs and audit trails can be forwarded to Acme's SIEM; SOC2 evidence shared.

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 1 (now): Exchange sample data + access details; finalize mutual action plan.
- Week 2: Setup private env + baseline tests.
- Week 3: Run evaluation, iterate on prompt/quantization.
- Week 4: Final readout + exec decision meeting.

Owners
- Redwood: me (AM lead), Rishi (solutions eng) for infra/runbook, Stephanie (CS) for onboarding/runbook.
- Acme: Sam (product), Olivia (security lead) for audit needs.

Next steps (action items)
1) Sam: share sample dataset + required redaction rules by EOD Thu.
2) Olivia: share SOC2 / security checklist contacts for evidence exchange.
3) Marissa/Rishi: circulate MutualActionPlan.pdf with proposed timelines by Fri.

I attached a short mutual action plan draft — please review and flag edits. Once we have the sample data and security contacts, Rishi will schedule the infra kickoff.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
